text: {"lessons":["Selling a position just because it is above my average cost can lock in a gain without improving my overall returns; I should consider the portfolio as a whole.","A stock’s past price movements do not predict its future, so I should avoid treating recent gains or losses as a reliable signal for my next trade.","I should not let the urge to avoid admitting a mistake dictate whether I hold or sell; make each decision based on what best serves my portfolio now."]}
